_asOfDate_note: Pins the dashboards to this date's quarter/window. null = auto-roll with the calendar.
_rr2Goals_note: rr2 scoreboard green-highlight thresholds (change in one spot). A rep's Rev/Sit or Close Rate turns green when it is >= the threshold (checked independently).
_rr2TargetSlots_note: Total rep slots on the scoreboard. Reps fill top-down; any remaining slots show as 'WE'RE HIRING / OPEN SEAT'. openSeats = max(0, rr2TargetSlots - reps). 7 slots with 5 reps = 2 open seats.
_reps_note: Display names only. WHO is on the sales team comes from rr-metrics settings.json (sales_team). Add a rep there; add a row here only to set a nicer display name/role.
_setter_note: Show every 'Appointment Set By' value EXCEPT these junk/inactive buckets (case-insensitive; blanks always excluded). New CSRs auto-appear. Janet excluded — left the company 2026-07-07.
_source_note: All data and metric rules come from rapidhsg/rr-metrics-data (data branch = AccuLynx sends, main branch = locked rules). This file only holds display settings. Never add an AccuLynx report or a metric definition here.
_freshness_note: Freshness chip on RR1/RR2: AccuLynx sends the job export at these Eastern times; the boards update about refreshLagMinutes later (pull + build). Change here if the AccuLynx schedule changes.
